text: Arthur was a resident in a psychiatric hospital who was confined indoors. The ward matron announced that fresh gingerbread from the local bakery had arrived for the patients. Arthur was asked to help the cleaning staff scrub the recreation hall floors before the dessert was distributed. While working, Arthur became distracted daydreaming about the gingerbread and accidentally spilled a bucket of soapy water across the clean floor. By the time the mess was mopped up, the inspection of the recreation hall was delayed, and the gingerbread had already been distributed to the other patients. Arthur was furious and slammed the dining hall door, having missed out on the gingerbread.
